title: Official Python SDK
author: typesafe-ai
summary: Official Python client with a minimal support-ticket classification example.
limitations: An integration resource, not a standalone application.

title: Jev for Home Assistant
author: AboveColin
summary: Ask questions about home state and return values for Home Assistant automations.
limitations: Requires Home Assistant; no physical devices were tested here.

title: Typesafe MCP
author: itsmostafa
summary: Expose Jev's typed decisions to coding assistants through an MCP server.
limitations: Requires client configuration and an API key.

title: Jev MCP (jkudish)
author: jkudish
summary: MCP tools for verification, filtering, reranking, classification, and code review.
limitations: Tools and interfaces may change between versions.

title: fast-jev-compaction
author: tamaratran
summary: Score tool calls and results, trim stale content, and keep retained text verbatim.
limitations: Discarded context may still matter; evaluate downstream task success.

title: Jev Codex Router
author: 0xNatoshi
summary: Choose a model and reasoning depth for each conversation turn using Jev.
limitations: Requires an existing Codex Router; reported savings were not reproduced here.

title: Foreman
author: thruwire
summary: Assess whether coding work is complete, sufficiently tested, or needs human input.
limitations: A completion judgment is not an independent correctness check.

title: Winnow
author: GhalebDweikat
summary: Filter large tool outputs before they enter context, with a way to restore hidden text.
limitations: Jev judges relevance; another model also produces summaries.

title: Jev Review (devagrawal09)
author: devagrawal09
summary: Review diffs or repositories through staged risk screening, evidence selection, and severity scoring.
limitations: Structured review signals do not replace tests.

title: Jev Review MCP
author: NiazMorshed2007
summary: A local MCP server supplies ongoing software-quality scores to coding agents.
limitations: The coding agent still makes repairs; a score is not proof of correctness.

title: Tripwire
author: noelzappy
summary: Check model responses before delivery, with middleware, proxy, and configurable policies.
limitations: Latency claims are unverified here; false positives and missed detections need evaluation.

title: jev-gates
author: rashedInt32
summary: Check coding-agent rules, scope, and completion claims, escalating when needed.
limitations: These gates escalate but never approve; they are not an authorization system.

title: pi-warden
author: DevMortimer
summary: Check edits and tool use against project rules, retry loops, and completion evidence.
limitations: Agent-specific integration; the author's measurements do not establish general performance.

title: jev-router
author: gargpratyush
summary: Route each new Claude Code or Codex turn to an appropriate model tier.
limitations: Depends on the original CLI and its authentication setup.

title: Safer with Jev
author: andrelandgraf
summary: Demonstrate content judgments combined with optional HTTPS request forwarding.
limitations: Hosted service and source evolve separately; forwarding was not tested here.

title: Triagedy
author: m0rphtail
summary: Turn JSONL security alerts into typed triage decisions in a Unix-style pipeline.
limitations: Evaluate alert handling on your own labeled dataset.

title: jev-shell-history
author: mrnugget
summary: Rank existing zsh history entries against what the user is typing.
limitations: History becomes model context; the demo uses fabricated history.

title: TypeSafe AI Playground (Rust CLI)
author: markjaquith
summary: Rust CLI experiments for private-information detection, comment review, tone, and business classification.
limitations: Privacy detection is experimental, not a compliance certification.

title: Jev Ultrafast
author: browser-use
summary: Choose a browser operation and target together from a dynamic table of page elements.
limitations: A small LLM writes free text; the flight demo searches but does not book.

title: typesafe-computer-use
author: awlevin
summary: Read a Mac interface with OCR and accessibility APIs, then let Jev choose an action.
limitations: Requires system permissions; some free text still uses a writing model.

title: Jev Browser
author: jkudish
summary: Control a browser through a library, CLI, or MCP, with budgets, recovery, and decision traces.
limitations: Operates a real browser; only the project documentation was reviewed here.

title: Mobile Jev
author: droidrun
summary: Select actions on a Mobilerun Android device from the current interface state.
limitations: The Uber demo reaches payment selection; it does not demonstrate a completed booking.

title: pg-jev
author: realZachi
summary: A PostgreSQL extension filters, ranks, and classifies rows with natural-language conditions.
limitations: Requires an extension and API calls; not installed on a local database here.

title: jevQL
author: kylemclaren
summary: Add client-side Jev judgments to queries against standard PostgreSQL.
limitations: The database executes ordinary queries; semantic evaluation happens outside it.

title: duckdb-jev
author: colliber
summary: Return typed judgments over tables or Parquet data from DuckDB queries.
limitations: Requires an extension and credentials; sample queries were not executed here.

title: Jev Logs
author: reachjalil
summary: Score OpenTelemetry logs before routing selected records to expensive analysis.
limitations: Preview project; uncertain records and provider failures should remain eligible for analysis.

title: neo4jev
author: jexp
summary: Choose the next graph relationship and check whether the goal is reached in the same call.
limitations: Requires Neo4j; path scores are not answer-accuracy estimates.

title: Unclutter
author: kitze
summary: Identify page clutter with Jev and reuse template rules in a browser extension.
limitations: May hide useful content; the extension was not installed here.

title: TypeSafe Fun AdBlocker
author: realZachi
summary: Classify DOM elements as ads and remove them with browser code.
limitations: The author describes a fun demo, not a complete ad blocker or tracking defense.

title: Jev Moderation Bot
author: brainstormity
summary: Moderate Discord spam and scam links with progressively stronger actions.
limitations: Can delete messages and penalize users; no Discord connection or error-rate evaluation was performed here.

title: JEVMETER
author: ChetasLua
summary: Score video transcripts sentence by sentence and render the results as an on-screen meter.
limitations: The author explicitly says these scores are not fact-checking conclusions.

related.label: Author demo on X (linked from README; post not independently verified)

title: jevcal
author: abhixhek
summary: Choose confidence thresholds on your own data and detect changes after model updates.
limitations: The bundled demo uses a simulator, not live API measurements.

title: Janus
author: FirasSX914
summary: Measure when to route between small and large models, including when routing should be rejected.
limitations: Unlabeled logs measure agreement, not accuracy against ground truth.

title: jev-benchmarks
author: AbdelStark
summary: Evaluate probability calibration, automation coverage, latency, and resource use.
limitations: Results depend on datasets, model versions, and evaluation design; not rerun here.

title: typesafe-ai-benchmark
author: iammrduncan
summary: Compare LLM structured output and Jev on matched application tasks.
limitations: Includes synthetic workloads; results do not directly generalize to production.

title: 1v1 Jev
author: emrickgarrett
summary: A browser arena uses Jev to choose a game character's actions.
limitations: Includes heuristic fallbacks; not all behavior is attributable to Jev.

title: TypeSafe Mario
author: fhshaik
summary: Translate emulator RAM and telemetry into state for Jev to select NES controller inputs.
limitations: An experimental controller; Jev does not receive screenshots.

title: Jev Plays StarCraft
author: phyous
summary: Drive a StarCraft shareware mission from structured state and record action probabilities.
limitations: One reported mission completion does not establish general game-playing ability.

title: Jev Pong
author: ably-labs
summary: Advance the Pong ball one step per model decision to visualize response latency.
limitations: Ball speed depends on call duration; this is not a fixed-clock skill benchmark.

title: jev-drone
author: RomanSlack
summary: Use Jev for situational judgments in a MuJoCo drone simulation while code handles fast control.
limitations: Jev does not see images directly; perception is converted to structured input first.

title: Jev Chess Lab
author: denikuchero
summary: Recorded chess experiments compare Jev alone, tactical filters, and Stockfish assistance.
limitations: The author reports solo Jev still loses pieces; rendered replays are not real-time recordings.

title: Jev for Social Media
author: socai-io
summary: Let Jev choose social-media operations while socai executes them in a browser.
limitations: The older video shows an earlier routing-only version, not the full current workflow.

title: Kill My Idea
author: monteduro
summary: Ask parallel questions about a startup idea and combine scores into a fixed verdict.
limitations: Scores do not predict business success; the author archives evaluations by default.

title: jev-secret-detection
author: teyhouse
summary: Use a Noul question to measure whether code snippets contain usable secret credentials.
limitations: Deliberately omits regex and provider verification; not a complete secret scanner.

title: Jev MCP (blakestone-x)
author: blakestone-x
summary: MCP tools and request recipes for classification, scoring, matching, and screening.
limitations: Several inputs in one state do not automatically receive separate classifications.

title: jev-llm
author: Code-Forge-AU
summary: Build a text-generation experiment by repeatedly selecting the next word from candidates.
limitations: Each step remains a bounded choice; this is not native free-text generation by Jev.
